name: Wave Accounting
description: Wave Accounting GraphQL API for businesses, customers, invoices, products and payments.

tools.name: graphql_query
tools.description: Run a read-only Wave GraphQL query. Use variables for account or business IDs; never place access tokens in the query.

tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List businesses available to the authenticated Wave user.

default_body.query: query { businesses { edges { node { id name } } } }

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers for a Wave business.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for a Wave business.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice through Wave GraphQL. Supply the provider's mutation input in input.
